task.title: Ask the evidence corpus
task.shortdesc: Ask a question in plain words. Each point of the answer cites a topic with its commit, date, approver and the requirements it answers.

step.cmd: On , type a question or pick a sample, then select Ask.
Read each point and its quote.

info.p: The quote is copied word for word from the cited topic. A point whose quote or numbers aren't in the topic is dropped and listed.
An evidence topic lists the requirements it answers in the trace. A requirement topic lists its evidence, or says it is a gap.
